en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed Try again on an open cloud or Remote Control session's "Connection lost" card sending "Try again" as your message; it now tries to reconnect instead
zh: [Claude Code 网页版] 修复在已打开的云 session 或远程控制 session 的“Connection lost”卡片上点击 Try again 时把“Try again”当作消息发送的问题；现在会改为尝试重连
